message: Fresh fact: night 2 I watched player_7 and saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 target them. player_5 is the healer (confirmed save), player_2 was the wolf, so player_10 needs to explain what they were doing on player_7 that night. I'm the Sentinel — that's my claim, one watch used, one used on player_4 night 1.

player_4, I never visited you — and there's a way to settle it. Your result would still show if it were true, so I'll say plainly: someone was at my door would be visible to me. Since nothing was, either your follow is invented or it's smoke. I'm voting player_4 today; pull it if you have a real result.

player_10, I had no checks left after night 2, so on night 3 I held — I made no visit, and I got no roleblock notice. So a real trailseer watching me would see exactly that. But my night-1 check on you read Not suspicious, so a fake trailseer from you fits necromancer or speculator. Which night are you saying you followed me — night 3, the one just passed?

Two things you're skating past, player_10. First, you deflect the follow dispute as "sort it tomorrow" — that's the one live contradiction we have, and it's exactly the kind of thing a wolf wants parked. Second, your whole case on me is "the wolf kill didn't land, so it hit the Necromancer" — but that assumes the pack aimed at a player they couldn't kill, when the simplest read is the pack's carrier hit a protected body. If player_6 is telling the truth about healing, the kill could have gone anywhere. I'm not claiming anything tonight; I'm saying your vote is built on a guess dressed as arithmetic.

One thing worth flagging on the player_3/player_4 clash: player_3's \"I hold no follow ability\" doesn't answer a follow result, and it doesn't answer a watch either. If player_4's track said player_3 came to him, the only way that's false is if player_4 invented it — so one of those two is lying, and I'd like player_3 to state his night action outright instead of arguing about wording.

You're right that I didn't visit anyone night 3 — I had no checks left. I'd already said on day 3 the last check was night 2 on player_8; the "check on player_5" was a plan I never got to run. So my record is nights 1 and 2 only: player_10 clean, player_8 clean. That matters for you — if player_3's watch is real, you're in line for the night-2 attack, but my check says you're not a wolf, so someone else carried it.

Nothing at my door, player_4 — I didn't visit you. You say you followed me; nobody came to you, so believe me when I say I'm not your danger. What made you pick me to follow? If you've a real result on someone, that's better spent than tailing me.

I'll put my night result on the table since day 1 gave us nothing else: I tracked player_6 and they targeted player_7. Sentinel fits — player_6 likely watched you, player_7. If so, did you learn anything, and did anyone get attacked but saved? That's the only lead we have right now.

player_1, that's my role you just claimed — I'm the Sigilist, and I've used neither sigil yet. So your \"sigil on player_3\" is a fabrication. What actually went to player_3 and killed a sentinel? You're the one player_10 saw there, so explain that honestly or you're my vote.

You're right that only the Necromancer is kill-proof on night one — that includes me, and it includes nobody. But the pack's miss doesn't prove the target; it means a wolf wasted a kill on an immune body, and the wolves know who they bit. Voting the quiet one on that alone is a guess. If you want something testable, hold player_3 and player_4 to the exact result wording before anyone votes.

player_7 said they'd check player_5 on night 3. I followed player_7 last night and they targeted nobody. Either that check never happened or player_7 got blocked — and player_5, who would have been the test, is dead. That's worth an explanation, player_7.

Time to close this out — both wolves are dead, so one of player_6 or player_8 is the Necromancer. I'm the Trailseer and my follows have checked out: I tracked player_1 onto player_3 on night 4, matching player_3's last night, and last night I followed player_6, who targeted no one. That's not a defence — the Necromancer can just hold the body. player_6, you've made no role claim all game; which role are you, and why did you hold last night?

Let's not waste the day on vibes — there's one threat left, the Necromancer, and it's player_6 or player_8. I'll commit to following one of you tonight, so tell me now: which body would you use and on whom? A Necromancer who claims a target and then shows up under a dead name on my track is caught, and one who claims nothing has to explain why.

I have a night result worth airing, because it's checkable: someone targeted me on night 1 and I want to hear them explain it before I say who. I'd rather you volunteer what you did on night 1 than have me call it out — that tells me more about you than the action itself. If nobody owns up, I'll name the player and we can question it then.

Trailseer here. Last night I tracked player_9, and they targeted player_4 — the same player who got struck by the sigil. That fits a sigilist hitting back at whoever attacked player_4, so whoever holds the sigil likely knows what happened there. Four of us left and one is the illusionist, one the killer — everyone should say whether they acted or held last night.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5, but the record shows player_5's own will already covers their nights — so did that check actually happen? And you told us night 2 you went to player_8; I want to know you didn't get blocked last night. If someone sat on you, say so now, because a silent investigator is exactly what a block looks like.

The night-3 kill was by a reanimated wolf, so the Necromancer is alive and gunning while a Chanteuse still blocks. player_3, player_10: did either of you see a night-3 visit that ties to that kill? A blocked player reads as 'targeted nobody', so last night's follow and watch are the cheapest test we have. I'd rather lynch on that than on player_7's dropped check.

player_4's own wording is the problem: \"player_3 visited player_4\" is what a watch on player_4 reports, not what a follow of player_3 reports. A follow tells you where the target went — it never names the person whose door they reached unless you were watching that door. So either player_4 is misreporting a watch as a follow, or the result is invented. player_3, did you visit anyone at all last night?

The cleanest thing here: player_4 claims a follow result that puts player_3 at his own door — that's the result reading I'd expect from a watch on himself, not a follow. Worth noting a follow can't show an attack either way, so \"no attack on me was announced\" isn't evidence the visit was harmless — a roleblock or a visit on a night I couldn't die would look identical. player_3, name what you actually did.

I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_6 and they targeted no one — but a necromancer who holds is invisible to a track, so that settles nothing by itself. player_6, you've made no role claim all game; which role are you, and did you ever use a dead body?

player_7, you told us your last check would go on player_5 last night. I have a follow that says you visited nobody on night 3. So did the check happen or not? If you held your last check on a night when the healer was your stated target and got killed, that needs explaining. I'd like that answer before I vote, because right now I'd be voting you.

Love, I never claimed your follow was wrong — I said the vote shouldn't be the wording slip. Here's the point nobody's made: player_1 died by sigil, which means the pack's bite landed and did nothing. Only one body shrugs off a night-one kill. That's the one death the town can't afford to leave alive. Test player_3 and player_4 tomorrow; spend tonight's vote on the killer who already ate a bullet.

On the player_3/player_4 clash: player_3's own claim doesn't actually clear them. A Sentinel watching player_4 isn't among the names their own watch reports, so player_3 could have visited player_4 and still truthfully report \"no one visited\" — player_4's follow isn't refuted by that watch at all. So the real question is whether player_4's follow is genuine; that needs a second result, not a wording argument.

The three people who voted player_4 yesterday were 7, 8 and 9 — and player_4 turned out to be the chanteuse. That bloc bothers me, but 9 is dead, so we can't read their info. Who among the survivors actually has a night result worth sharing today? Staying silent just helps the serial killer and illusionist hide.

player_3, I've got you visiting me last night. That doesn't mean anything bad — a healer or a sigil placement would look identical — but I want to hear what you were doing on me before I trust you. If your story is straight, we both learn something.

player_7, you told us the last check was going on player_5 night 3. What did it actually read, and why should we trust it when your night-1 and night-2 accounts already conflict with player_8? If that check was never made, say so now rather than later — that's the difference between a sloppy claim and a lie.

I followed player_1 last night and saw them visit player_3, who died to the wolves. That visit means player_1 is either the Chanteuse blocking or a town night role — but it rules them out as Necromancer or Speculator. So the Necromancer is player_6 or player_8, and one of them is the Speculator too. I'd like player_1 to say outright what they did at player_3's door.

player_4, that's odd, because I watched my own door and saw nothing come to me last night. If you really followed me here, someone would've shown up at my step — the follow is a visit. So either your follow is fiction, or you're describing something that didn't happen. Which is it?

player_5 is right on the Sentinel mechanics, and there's a second problem with player_3's story: no one has produced a wolf kill on night 1 at all — so the pack's shot hit something that can't die (the Necromancer only), not player_4's door. So player_3's 'empty door' watch says nothing about the missing wolf kill. My vote leans player_3 today.

Yes, player_3, I did visit player_7 on night 2 — my follow is what shows me that. But the contradiction stands, player_7: my night-3 follow showed you targeting no one, so your claimed check on player_5 never happened. Which is it — you held the check, or the check claim was just talk?

player_4, I'll answer it plainly: I visited nobody on night 1, and there's a hard reason I can say that with certainty, not just denial. Nobody came to your door last night — that's my own night result, and it's the opposite of the one you're quoting. So the question isn't what I did at your door; it's why you invented a visitor for it.

The night-4 trail is the whole game here: player_10 saw player_1 go to player_3, and player_3 died to the wolves that same night. A sigil placed on a target has no effect if they didn't attack — but the carrier of the wolf kill also just walks to the victim, so "no effect" covering the kill visit is the same story either way. player_1, what did your sigil do on nights 1-3?

Careful — I never went to your door. I watched you last night and nobody visited you at all, which is a result I'd rather not have had to say out loud. So either your follow is fabricated or you're reading something wrong; which is it, and what role are you claiming?

Hold on, player_1 — I'm the Sigilist. Nobody else claimed it all game, and you're claiming it now, so one of us is lying, and I know it's you. Two sigils in the whole game and you say you burned one on player_3 on night 4 'with no effect'? That's the least testable story you could tell. What did your night 1-3 sigils do, exactly?

I followed player_6 last night and they visited no one — that doesn't clear them, since a Necromancer can just stay put. player_6, you're the only survivor who's never claimed anything or given a single night result across five nights. What did you actually do on nights 1 through 5? Give me one concrete answer, not a shrug.

player_6, you're the one person who has never claimed anything, and both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is you or player_8. I followed you last night — you visited no one, which tells me nothing either way since a body-user can stay put. So: what are you, and what did you do on nights 1 through 5? If you can't name a role that's still in the cast, my vote's on you.

player_4, you've got a real point: my push on player_7 was thin and I said so. Here's the substance — there was exactly one announced death last night, and it was a sigil, not a bite. So the pack hit someone who couldn't die on night 1, and player_7 is the only kind of body that survives that. I'll say plainly I have no night claim tonight, and I'm voting player_7, not the wording fight.

I have something concrete for the table: last night I followed player_3 and they targeted me — me specifically, player_4. That doesn't confirm a role, since healer, sentinel, trailseer, sigilist and chanteuse all target a player, but I'd like player_3 to say up front what they did to me, so I can check it against what I saw rather than everything they say after hearing this.

Night one cost us both the Sentinel and the Healer, so we're light on info already. Worth flagging: I have a partial night result that puts someone at player_7's door last night, and I want to hear player_7 explain what they did before I say more. player_7, walk me through your night.

I'm the trailseer as claimed. Night 1 the dead sentinel player_6 visited player_7; night 2 player_9 visited player_4, the night player_4 was struck by a sigil. An investigator doesn't visit, but a sigilist does — though player_9 claimed investigator, that visit could just as well be a sigilist placing the strike. Worth weighing before anyone treats player_9 as cleared.

Here's the spot we're in: both wolves are dead, so the Necromancer is either you, player_6, or player_8. player_8 has at least put a role claim on the table. You haven't claimed anything all game, and player_6, you're the only one who can be the Necromancer if every claim holds. So: what have you done on nights 3 and 4, when there were kills or a reanimated wolf on the board? I followed you last night and you went nowhere, which is a fine alibi for last night and useless for the rest.

I have one real result from night 1: I followed player_6, and player_6 went to visit player_7. Player_6 turned out to be the sentinel, so that was probably a watch on player_7 — meaning something else visited player_7 too, possibly the Sigilist placing a sigil. player_7, what did you do night 1 and who came to you? If you can't account for a sentinel being on you, I'm voting there.

Building on player_9's question: player_3, if you watched player_4 and no one visited, then for player_4's follow to be true someone else at that door is unnamed — but you also said you visited no one, so your own watch result should list you as a visitor to player_4 and doesn't. That's the contradiction to pin. I'd vote to test player_3's story today unless he explains how a Sentinel watching a door doesn't show himself at it.

I followed someone last night and got a hit worth putting on the table: player_3 visited me. That's a visit, not proof of intent — but I want player_3 to say what they were doing at my door. A healer or a curious town role explains it; a wolf looking for a kill target doesn't.

There's a clean mechanical split neither of you named: if player_3 really watched player_4's door, then player_3's own Sentinel visit should have shown on a follow of player_3 — but player_4 says the follow showed player_3 going to player_4, which is exactly what the Sentinel watch visit would look like. So player_4's follow is actually consistent with p3 being the Sentinel. The real contradiction is p3 saying the door was empty while admitting he went there himself — the watch is not among its own reported visitors. One of you is lying about the result wording.

Two things I want on the record before the vote. First, player_7: you say you checked player_10 night 1 and player_8 night 2, but player_8 says they were checked night 1. One of you is wrong about which night — which is it, player_8? Second, player_10, what did you do on night 2? Just say it plainly.

Which is it? It's invented. I'm the Sentinel, and I watched player_4 last night — no one targeted them, so there was no visit at their door, mine or anyone's. A real follow showing me arriving at player_4 is impossible against that. Cast a vote on player_4 and stop entertaining the 'wording' angle.
